query:
select exists (select 1 from envoi_depot
                          where etat = 'en_cours' and quand > now() - make_interval(mins => $1))
               or exists (select 1 from brouillon_reponse
                          where statut = 'envoi' and modifie_le > now() - make_interval(mins => $1))
           as "e!"
